zones.name: Base Camp
zones.pitch: Three core skills everyone uses every day. Finish any two to open the map.

zones.name: Money Moves
zones.pitch: Payslips, phone plans, budgets and the fine print. Keep more of your cash.

zones.name: Work Ready
zones.pitch: Job ads, resumes, workplace talk and interviews. Get the job, keep the job.

zones.name: Digital Life
zones.pitch: Fakes, feeds, influencers and comment sections. Run your phone, don’t let it run you.

zones.name: Get Sorted
zones.pitch: Forms, transport, L-plates, health and your rights. Adulting, sorted.

zones.name: Your Voice
zones.pitch: Stories, reviews, lyrics, complaints and speeches. Say what you mean and be heard.

zones.name: Crossroads
zones.pitch: Big real-world missions that mix two zones. Unlock by going deep in both.

skills.title: Spot the Scam
skills.tagline: Don’t get played by a dodgy text.
skills.realLife: Recognise scam messages and know what to do before you click, pay or reply.
skills.literacy: Reading for purpose and audience; spotting persuasive tricks; reading between the lines (inference).

skills.title: Say It Right
skills.tagline: Text your mate. Email your boss. Know the difference.
skills.realLife: Choose the right tone and words for who you’re talking to — friends, teachers, bosses, services.
skills.literacy: Formal and informal language (register); writing short messages for a purpose and audience.

skills.title: Find It Fast
skills.tagline: Get the info you need in 30 seconds, not 30 minutes.
skills.realLife: Skim and scan websites, menus, timetables and signs to find what you need quickly.
skills.literacy: Skimming and scanning; using headings, tables and links to navigate texts.

skills.title: Read Your Payslip
skills.tagline: Did you get paid right? Find out.
skills.realLife: Read a payslip: hours, pay rate, gross and net pay, tax and super. Spot mistakes.
skills.literacy: Reading information in tables; technical vocabulary; checking literal details.

skills.title: Phone Plan Showdown
skills.tagline: Which deal is actually the best deal?
skills.realLife: Compare phone plans and spot what the ads don’t tell you.
skills.literacy: Comparing information across texts; persuasive language in ads; reading the small print.

skills.title: Budget Builder
skills.tagline: Make your money last till next payday.
skills.realLife: Make a simple weekly budget and a savings goal you can actually stick to.
skills.literacy: Reading charts and tables; writing a clear plan with steps (procedural text).

skills.title: Buy Smart Online
skills.tagline: Reviews, refunds and ‘Buy now, pay later’.
skills.realLife: Check if a seller is legit, read reviews critically and know your refund rights.
skills.literacy: Evaluating reliability of sources; fact versus opinion; persuasive language.

skills.title: Beat the Fine Print
skills.tagline: Gym memberships, contracts and sneaky fees.
skills.realLife: Read a contract or terms and conditions and work out what you’re really agreeing to.
skills.literacy: Reading complex texts; technical vocabulary; summarising key points; inference.

skills.title: Crack the Job Ad
skills.tagline: What do they actually want?
skills.realLife: Read job ads, decode the jargon and decide if a job is right for you.
skills.literacy: Finding key information; technical and workplace vocabulary; inference.

skills.title: Safety First at Work
skills.tagline: Signs, steps and staying in one piece.
skills.realLife: Read workplace safety signs, instructions and procedures, and ask when unsure.
skills.literacy: Reading procedural texts; symbols and images in texts; following and writing instructions.

skills.title: Build Your Resume
skills.tagline: One page that gets you the call.
skills.realLife: Write a one-page resume that shows your skills, even with no work experience.
skills.literacy: Text structure and layout; concise, precise vocabulary; editing for audience.

skills.title: Talk the Talk at Work
skills.tagline: Calling in sick, asking questions, emailing the boss.
skills.realLife: Handle everyday work talk: shift swaps, calling in sick, asking for help, workplace emails.
skills.literacy: Formal language and tone; spoken interaction skills; short workplace messages.

skills.title: Nail the Interview
skills.tagline: Walk in nervous. Walk out confident.
skills.realLife: Prepare for and answer common interview questions using real examples from your life.
skills.literacy: Planning and delivering spoken answers; listening; structuring examples (STAR).

skills.title: Fact or Fake?
skills.tagline: Don’t share it till you check it.
skills.realLife: Check whether a post, video or news story is real before you believe or share it.
skills.literacy: Evaluating reliability of sources; comparing information across texts.

skills.title: Your Digital Footprint
skills.tagline: What does the internet say about you?
skills.realLife: Think about who sees your posts and write a profile/bio you’d be happy for a boss to read.
skills.literacy: Audience and purpose; writing short texts for a public audience.

skills.title: Influencer Unboxed
skills.tagline: Is it a review… or an ad?
skills.realLife: Spot sponsored content and the tricks influencers use to sell to you.
skills.literacy: Persuasive techniques in multimodal texts; how images and words position viewers.

skills.title: Comment Section Survival
skills.tagline: Disagree without losing it.
skills.realLife: Respond to online conflict, stand up for someone, and know when and how to report.
skills.literacy: Language for respectful disagreement; tone; evaluative language.

skills.title: Make Content That Counts
skills.tagline: Script it. Shoot it. Post it right.
skills.realLife: Plan, script and storyboard a short video or post that says something useful.
skills.literacy: Creating multimodal texts; scripting; choosing images, words and sound for an audience.

skills.title: Form Filler
skills.tagline: Bank accounts, TFNs and Medicare cards — done right.
skills.realLife: Fill in official forms accurately: bank account, Tax File Number, Medicare.
skills.literacy: Reading instructions closely; form vocabulary; accurate, legible responses.

skills.title: Getting Around
skills.tagline: Maps, timetables and not missing the last train.
skills.realLife: Plan a trip using maps, timetables and journey-planner apps.
skills.literacy: Reading tables, maps and symbols; following and giving directions.

skills.title: L-Plate Ready
skills.tagline: Get ready for your learner permit test.
skills.realLife: Read and understand road rules so you’re ready for the learner permit knowledge test.
skills.literacy: Reading information texts; technical vocabulary; diagrams and signs; answering test questions.

skills.title: Health Smart
skills.tagline: Medicine labels, appointments and good info.
skills.realLife: Read medicine labels, book an appointment and find health info you can trust.
skills.literacy: Reading labels and instructions; evaluating sources; asking clear questions.

skills.title: Know Your Rights
skills.tagline: At work, renting and with police.
skills.realLife: Find and understand your rights as a young person at work and when renting, and ask for help.
skills.literacy: Reading legal-style information; summarising; writing a formal request.

skills.title: Tell Your Story
skills.tagline: Your life is worth writing about.
skills.realLife: Tell a true story from your life in a way that grabs people.
skills.literacy: Personal recount and narrative; descriptive language; structure (hook, build, ending).

skills.title: Review It
skills.tagline: Rate games, films and food like a critic.
skills.realLife: Write an honest review that helps other people decide.
skills.literacy: Opinions with reasons; evaluative language; persuasive structure.

skills.title: Lyrics Decoded
skills.tagline: What’s that song really about?
skills.realLife: Unpack the meaning in songs you love and write some lines of your own.
skills.literacy: Figurative language, imagery, rhythm and rhyme in song lyrics and poetry.

skills.title: Complain Like a Pro
skills.tagline: Get your money back. Get it fixed.
skills.realLife: Write a complaint email or make a call that actually gets results.
skills.literacy: Persuasive and formal writing; structure (problem, evidence, request); tone.

skills.title: Speak Up
skills.tagline: Say something that matters — out loud.
skills.realLife: Plan and give a short speech about an issue you care about.
skills.literacy: Persuasive speaking; structure; persuasive techniques; delivery.

skills.title: Get the Job
skills.tagline: From ad to offer — the full run.
skills.realLife: Apply for a real (or realistic) local job: tailored resume, cover email and mock interview.
skills.literacy: Synthesising skills: reading the ad, writing for an audience, speaking with confidence.

skills.title: Move Out Ready
skills.tagline: Rental applications, leases and bills.
skills.realLife: Find a rental, read a lease, budget for bills and write a rental application.
skills.literacy: Reading complex documents; comparing options; writing formal applications.

skills.title: Side Hustle
skills.tagline: Turn a skill into cash.
skills.realLife: Plan a small side hustle: pitch it, price it and promote it online.
skills.literacy: Persuasive multimodal texts; pitching; writing for customers.

skills.title: Change Maker
skills.tagline: Start a campaign for something you care about.
skills.realLife: Run a mini campaign: a petition, a social post and a short speech for a cause.
skills.literacy: Persuasive texts across modes; positioning an audience; evaluating impact.
